At UIE we implement Qlaas, which connects AI agents to the systems your teams already use. You decide what each agent can do, which decisions need approval and how to check the result.

For commercial & hospitality teams, these are the three workflows we would look at first:

Commercial & hospitality: where a pilot could start
  01: Guest request coordination
  02: Returns and after-sales
  03: Supplier invoice handling

Our commercial & hospitality page puts it like this: “Connect customer requests to the teams and systems that fulfil them. Keep reservations, after-sales and finance aligned, so customers receive a confirmed outcome rather than another handover.” For each workflow it sets out the request, the work, who keeps authority and the evidence that closes the case. There is also a calculator for putting a value on the time at your own case volumes.
